name: playrates
description: PlayRates is a Video Game Tracking website.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @playrates/shared && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @playrates/shared && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend
